comments.text: All these videos are from Dhaka, I don't get the fact why people are acting like living here will kill you.. Our culture is good and if you are kind with us, we will be kind to you too. But actually please come to Sherpur!! It is covered with trees and nature and is very suitable for living, but not ideal for visiting because it only has a few tourist places.
